name: Odri

lines.text: Careful in the cutting. The sleepers go through where the roots have had them.
Chairs, plates, bolts. Good iron, better than anything anybody smelts now, and there is a hundred miles of it under that green.
Two lines. Nobody believes me till they walk the second bank. Two lines, and one lifted before the other stopped.
What ran on it? Something that needed doubling. That is all the iron will tell you and I have asked it a lot.

notes: Knows the Age of Machinery from the wrong end -- as a source of good metal -- which is the honest way a person in a forest would know it. Odri has better evidence about the era than any scholar on the map and no framework to put it in, and is entirely content with that.
